name: Practice (judge test)
time_limit_source: made up for the practice contest
statement_html:
A · Add Them Up

Input: one line with n (1 ≤ n ≤ 106), one line with n integers ai (|ai| ≤ 109). Output their sum.

B · Average Speed

Input: one line with n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105), one line with n integers vi (0 ≤ vi ≤ 106). Output their average, with absolute or relative error at most 10-7.

Ready-made submissions for every verdict are in practice/examples/.
